property_summary: After any call to newGrantProposal, the value of proposalCount on the reference contract is always strictly greater than the last emitted proposalID in its NewProposal event, while the buggy contract can fail this because it never increments proposalCount, so a subsequent call emits a stale ID equal to proposalCount.

For any sequence of calls to newGrantProposal, the reference contract's proposalCount strictly equals the number of successful newGrantProposal calls, while the buggy contract's proposalCount remains equal to the number of successful newGrantProposal calls before the first call.

After any sequence of calls to newGrantProposal, proposalCount must be equal to the number of calls made (i.e., increment by 1 per call), but the mutant increments by 2, causing proposalCount to exceed the number of calls.
After any call to newGrantProposal, the state variable proposalCount must always equal the proposal ID used for the stored GrantDetails in mapPID_grant.

After any external call to newGrantProposal, the state variable proposalCount on the reference contract is always exactly one less than the ID under which mapPID_grant was stored, whereas the buggy version stores the grant at the incremented ID while emitting an unincremented one, causing the value of proposalCount to differ between the two implementations after finishing.
